summary: 为满足东帝汶社区的饮水需求，托尼·弗林开发了一种可用本地材料制作的低成本陶土滤水器。多孔陶壁能够截留微生物，免用专门窑炉使这项设计更适合资源有限的地区。

paragraphs.brief: 常见原料做成低成本陶滤器
sentences: A handful of clay, yesterday’s coffee grounds and some cow manure are the ingredients that could bring clean, safe drinking water to many developing countries.
一把黏土、前一天留下的咖啡渣和一些牛粪，有望让许多发展中国家获得清洁、安全的饮用水。

The simple new technology, developed by Australian National University (ANU) materials scientist and potter Tony Flynn, allows water filters to be made from commonly available materials and fired (or baked) using cow manure as the source of heat, without the need for a kiln (an oven for baking or drying pottery).
澳大利亚国立大学材料科学家兼陶艺师托尼·弗林开发的简单新技术，可以利用常见材料制作滤水器，以牛粪为热源烧制，不必使用陶窑。
The filters have been tested and shown to remove common pathogens (disease-producing organisms) including E. coli.
过滤器经过测试并显示去除常见病原体(产生疾病的生物体)，包括大肠杆菌。
paragraphs.gist: 澳大利亚研究者弗林把常见的黏土、咖啡渣和牛粪用于制作不用窑炉的净水器，文中测试显示它能去除包括大肠杆菌在内的常见病原体。

paragraphs.brief: 从东帝汶试点到免窑改进
sentences: The invention was born out of a project involving the Manatuto community in East Timor.
这项发明是在东帝汶马纳图托社区参与的一个项目中产生的。

A charity operating there wanted to help set up a small industrial site manufacturing water filters, but initial research found the local clay to be too fine — a problem solved by the addition of organic material.
当地的一个慈善机构希望帮助建立一个小型工业场地，制造水过滤器，但初步研究发现当地粘土太精细——增加有机材料解决了这个问题。
While the problems of producing a working ceramic filter in East Timor were overcome, the solution was kiln-based and particular to that community’s materials and couldn’t be applied elsewhere.
研究者虽然在东帝汶成功制出了能用的陶瓷滤器，但这种方法依赖窑炉和该社区特有的材料，无法直接移用于别处。
Flynn’s technique for manure firing, with no requirement for a kiln, has made this zero-technology approach available anywhere it is needed.
弗林无需窑炉的牛粪烧制法，使这种几乎不依赖设备的办法可用于其他有需要的地方。
paragraphs.gist: 东帝汶社区以加入有机材料解决当地黏土太细的问题，但原方案依赖窑炉和特定材料，弗林后来改用牛粪烧制，使做法更易推广。

paragraphs.brief: 低成本滤罐的材料与制作
sentences: Other commercial clay filters do exist, but, even if available, with prices starting at US$5 each, they are often outside the budgets of most people in the developing world.
市面上还有其他陶质滤水器，但即使有货，每个至少五美元的价格也常超出发展中国家多数人的预算。
Unlike other water filtering devices, Flynn’s filters are inexpensive and simple to produce.
Flynn的过滤器与其他水过滤装置不同，价格低廉，生产简便。

Take a handful of clay, mix it with a handful of organic material such as used tea leaves, coffee grounds or rice hulls, add water in a sufficient quantity to make a stiff mixture and form a cylindrical pot that has one end closed, then dry it in the sun.
将一把黏土和一把用过的茶叶、咖啡渣或稻壳之类的有机材料混合，加入适量水调成较硬的泥料，做成一端封闭的圆筒形陶罐，然后晒干。
According to Flynn, used coffee grounds have given the best results to date.
弗林表示，目前用过的咖啡渣效果最好。
The walls of the filter can be measured using the width of an adult finger as the standard.
过滤器的墙壁可以用成人手指的宽度作为标准进行测量。
Next, surround the pots with straw, put them in a mound of cow manure, light the straw and then top up the burning manure as required.
接着用稻草围住陶罐，置入牛粪堆，点燃稻草，再根据燃烧情况适量补充牛粪。
The filters are finished in 45 to 60 minutes.
过滤器在45到60分钟内完成
paragraphs.gist: 与价格可能超出当地家庭负担的商品过滤器相比，弗林的方案用黏土和茶渣等制成滤罐，晒干后烧制，过程只需普通材料。

paragraphs.brief: 干牛粪作燃料的升温优势
sentences: The properties of cow manure are vital, as the fuel can reach a temperature of 700 degrees in half an hour, and will be up to 950 degrees after another 20 to 30 minutes.
牛粪的特性至关重要，因为燃料在半小时内能达到700度，再过20至30分钟，将达到950度。
The manure makes a good fuel because it is very high in organic material that burns readily and quickly.
牛粪是好燃料，因为它的有机物含量很高，点燃容易、燃烧也快。
The manure has to be dry and is best used exactly as found in the field; there is no need to break it up or process it any further.
牛粪必须晒干，最好就保持田里捡到时的原状，不需要打碎或进一步加工。
In contrast, a potter’s kiln is an expensive item and can take up to four or five hours to get up to 800 degrees.
相比之下，陶工的窑炉是一件昂贵的物品，可以花四、五个小时才能达到800度。
It needs expensive, scarce fuel, such as gas or wood to heat it, and experience to use it.
它需要昂贵、稀缺的燃料，如燃气或木材，并需要经验来使用。
With no technology, no insulation and nothing other than a pile of cow manure and a match, none of these requirements apply.
新办法只要一堆牛粪和一根火柴，无须专门技术或保温设施，因而免去了上述种种条件。
paragraphs.gist: 干牛粪富含易燃有机质，能迅速升至较高温度，因此可省去传统陶窑、昂贵燃料和熟练操作等要求。

paragraphs.brief: 牛粪燃料易得且性质相近
sentences: It is also helpful that, like clay and organic material, cow manure is freely available across the developing world.
同样有益的是，像粘土和有机材料一样，牛粪可以免费在发展中世界获得。
A cow is a natural fuel factory.
奶牛是天然燃料工厂
Manure is a mixture of vegetable materials of different sizes, and cow manure as a fuel is the same wherever it is found.
牛粪混合了大小不一的植物残余，无论产自哪里，用作燃料时的特性都一样。
paragraphs.gist: 牛粪和黏土一样，在许多需要净水的地区很容易获得，而且各地牛粪都由大小不一的植物残余组成，作为燃料的性质相近。

paragraphs.brief: 利用陶器原本容易渗水的特点
sentences: Just as using manure as a fuel for domestic use is not a new idea, the fact that liquid can pass through clay objects is something that potters have always known, and clay’s porous nature is something that, as a former ceramics lecturer in the ANU School of Art, Flynn is well aware of.
用粪便作家庭燃料早已有之，陶匠也早就知道液体能渗过陶器；弗林曾在澳大利亚国立大学艺术学院讲授陶艺，自然熟悉黏土的多孔性。
The difference is that, rather than viewing the porous nature of the material as a problem — after all, not many people want a pot that won’t hold water — his filters capitalize on this property.
区别在于，他没有把材料的多孔性视为缺陷——毕竟少有人想要一个漏水的罐子——而是让滤水器利用这个特性。
paragraphs.gist: 陶器会因多孔而渗水，制陶时通常要避免这一点，弗林却把这种人人熟悉的材料特性转化成了过滤器的工作原理。

paragraphs.brief: 滤孔截留细菌的原理与测试
sentences: The filtration process is simple, but effective.
过滤过程简单但有效。
The basic principle is that there are passages through the filter that are wide enough for water droplets to pass through, but too narrow for pathogens.
基本原则是，过滤器的通道足够宽，可以让水滴通过，但对于病原体来说过于狭窄。
Tests with the deadly E. coli bacterium have seen the filters remove 96.4 to 99.8 per cent of the pathogen — well within safe levels.
在针对可致命的大肠杆菌的试验中，滤器去除了 96.4% 至 99.8% 的细菌，文中称剩余含量在安全范围以内。
The thickness of the clay container needs to be the same thickness as an adult finger for the process to be effective.
粘土容器的厚度必须与成年手指的厚度相同，才能使工艺有效。
If this is the case, using only one filter, a liter of water can be obtained in two hours.
如果情况如此，只使用一个过滤器，两小时后即可获得一公升水。
paragraphs.gist: 滤罐的小孔可让水通过却截留较大的病原体，文中给出的实验去除率为百分之九十六点四至九十九点八，单个滤罐约两小时滤出一升。

paragraphs.brief: 有机材料烧尽留下过滤孔隙
sentences: The use of organic material, which burns away leaving cavities after firing, helps produce the structure in which pathogens will become trapped.
有机材料在烧制时会烧尽并留下孔隙，形成能够截留病原体的结构。
It overcomes the potential problems of finer clays that may not let water through and also means that cracks are soon halted.
这既解决了细黏土可能不透水的问题，也使裂缝难以继续扩展。
And like clay and cow manure, organic material is universally available in the developing communities that need the most assistance, as tea, coffee and rice are grown in these areas.
象粘土和牛粪一样，有机材料在最需要帮助的发展中社区普遍供应，因为这些地区种植茶叶、咖啡和大米。
paragraphs.gist: 有机材料烧尽后留下的孔隙既能截留病原体，又能让原本太细的黏土透水、阻止裂缝延伸，茶渣、咖啡渣和稻壳也容易就地取得。

paragraphs.brief: 放弃专利使社区可自由采用
sentences: With all the components being widely available, Flynn says there is no reason the technology couldn’t be applied throughout the developing world.
弗林说，所需材料随处可得，这项技术完全有可能在整个发展中世界采用。
He has no plans to exploit his idea financially by registering ownership through a patent.
他不打算通过申请专利取得所有权，从这项发明中牟利。
If he did, any commercial copying would legally entitle him to a share in any profits made.
如果他这样做了，任何商业复制将在法律上使他有权分享任何利润。
Without a patent, there will be no illegality in it being adopted in any community that needs it.
不申请专利，任何需要这项技术的社区都可以合法采用它。
“Everyone has a right to clean water, and these filters have the potential to enable anyone in the world to drink water safely,” says Flynn.
Flynn说，“每个人都有清洁水的权利，这些过滤器有可能使世界上的任何人能够安全地饮用水。
paragraphs.gist: 弗林认为材料普遍易得，便决定不靠专利独占收益，让需要的社区都可以自由采用这项净水技术。

items.en: Step-by-step guide to making Flynn’s water filters Make the mixture for the filter from organic material (e.g., tea, coffee, rice), ________ and ____ (Q15)
items.zh: 制作弗林滤水器时，先把茶、咖啡或米等有机材料与________和________（Q15）混合。
items.why: 题干要两项材料。第4段先说“clay”,后说“add water”。因此14=clay。

items.en: Step-by-step guide to making Flynn’s water filters Make the mixture for the filter from organic material (e.g., tea, coffee, rice), ____ (Q14) and ________
items.zh: 制作弗林滤水器时，先把茶、咖啡或米等有机材料与________（Q14）和________混合。
items.why: 与14成对出现。“add water” 即加入 water。

items.en: Shape into pots and place them in a fire made from ________ and ____ (Q17)
items.zh: 把混合物做成罐状，放入用________和________（Q17）生起的火中。
items.why: 火的材料来自文中明确的两种: straw 与 cow manure。

items.en: Shape into pots and place them in a fire made from ____ (Q16) and ________
items.zh: 把混合物做成罐状，放入用________（Q16）和________生起的火中。
items.why: 第二种燃料材料为 cow manure。

items.en: Fuel the fire to reach a maximum temperature of ________
items.zh: 添加燃料，使火的最高温度达到________。
items.why: 题干问“最高温度”,对应“up to 950 degrees”。

items.en: Bake the filters in the fire for a maximum period of ________
items.zh: 把滤水器放在火中烧制，时间最多为________。
items.why: 题干强调“maximum period (最长时长)”,故取区间上限 60 minutes。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空最多填两个词，可含数字。

items.en: The clay in the Manatuto project was initially unsuitable for the purpose of the project.
items.zh: Manatuto项目的粘土最初不适合该项目的目的。
items.why: “太细” 意味着初始不适用，与题干一致，故 TRUE。

items.en: Coffee grounds produce filters that are twice as efficient as those using other organic materials.
items.zh: 用咖啡渣制成的过滤器，其过滤效率是使用其他有机材料制成的过滤器的两倍。
items.why: 使用咖啡渣的滤器迄今效果最好，但文章没有量化为其他有机材料的两倍。

items.en: It takes half an hour for a cow manure fire to reach 950 degrees.
items.zh: 牛粪要花半小时才能达到950度
items.why: 半小时只能到700度。到950度需再20-30分钟，因此与题干相反,FALSE。

items.en: E. coli is the most difficult bacterium to remove from water by filtration.
items.zh: 在水中的各种细菌里，大肠杆菌最难通过过滤去除。
items.why: 文中未声称“最难去除",仅给出去除比例。缺乏比较对象，故 NOT GIVEN。

items.en: The Manatuto project aimed to set up a
items.zh: 马纳图托项目旨在建立一个
correct: 一家生产滤水器的工厂。

items.en: To be effective, the Flynn filters must
items.zh: 弗林的滤水器要发挥作用，必须具备什么条件？

items.en: Flynn does not intend to patent his filter because he
items.zh: Flynn不想给他的过滤器申请专利因为他
correct: wants it to be freely available.
希望有需要的人都能自由采用这项技术。

pairs: 第 4 段 · 第 4 句
第 6 段 · 第 2 句
第 3 段 · 第 1 句
points: 半小时只能到700度。到950度需再20-30分钟，因此与题干相反,FALSE。
题干问“最高温度”,对应“up to 950 degrees”。
clauses: A handful of clay, yesterday’s coffee grounds and some cow manure are the ingredients ….
“that could bring clean, safe drinking water to many developing countries”修饰前面的 ingredients。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 ingredients，再把修饰信息接回主句。
…, the solution was kiln-based and particular to that community’s materials and couldn’t be applied elsewhere.
连接词 while 引出“While the problems of producing a working ceramic filter in East Timor were overcome”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: An ingenious invention is set to bring clean water to developing countries, and while the science may be cutting edge, the materials are extremely down to earth.
一项巧妙的发明有望让发展中国家的人们喝上洁净的水；它用的科学原理也许前沿，材料却朴素而易得。
